candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) when _owner is zero, otherwise return _owner (alters returned value when _owner is not set).
Require newOwner to be non-zero removed so transferOwnership allows setting owner to address(0) (renouncing) even via transferOwnership.
Change modifier from onlyOwner to no modifier so anyone can call transferOwnership to change contract owner.
Invert onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT the owner, so only non-owners can call owner-only functions (including transferOwnership).
Return a fixed literal string instead of the stored _name, causing name() to return a different value.
Return a constant different symbol string instead of the stored _symbol.
